sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Mohd. Faris and
 Kumar, Advocates.

versus
 State Govt Of Nct Delhi & Ors.

Through: Mr. Laksh Khanna, 
 with Insp. Harish 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Ohri
 Order
% 12.11.2024
1.
By way of present petition, the petitioners seeks quashing of FIR No. 98/2021 registered under Sections 406/420/120B IPC at P.S. EOW.

2. Ld. APP for the State, on instructions, states that in the present FIR there are 10 victims however,
no settlement has been arrived with one of the victims i.e. Mr. Ronaldus Vincent.
He, on further instructions, submits that presently Mr. Ronaldus Vincent is not traceable.
3. At this stage, ld. counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are willing to deposit Rs.33,250/-, pertaining to the aforesaid victim, before the Trial Court.
4. Issue notice to the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 through all permissible modes, returnable on 10.12.2024.
